title: Simple icons
body:
**Simple icons**
Transform your Minecraft experience with this minimalist texture pack that will update your interface! With clean and clear icons for hunger hearts, armor, and other UI elements, it has an elegant and modern style. Perfect for players who prefer a simple and modern look.
